post.title: Hiring Freelance Writers – Remote, Ongoing Work
post.body:
Hiring Freelance Writers – Remote, Ongoing Work

I’m looking for skilled and dependable freelance writers to help with ongoing content-writing, rewriting, and editing projects.

What you’ll do:

- Rewrite and improve existing content while preserving its intended meaning
- Create clear, engaging, and original copy
- Edit content for grammar, readability, tone, and accuracy
- Follow project guidelines and meet agreed deadlines

What I’m looking for:

- Strong written English
- Excellent attention to detail
- Reliable communication and responsiveness
- Previous writing, editing, or content experience is preferred but not required

Work details:

- Fully remote
- Ongoing projects available
- Flexible workload depending on availability
- Compensation is discussed based on the project, workload, and experience
- Start: Immediately

If you’re interested, please comment or send me a DM with:

1. A brief introduction
2. Your writing/editing experience
3. Your availability
4. A sample of your previous work (if available)

Please note: This is freelance project work, not a salaried employment position. Specific project details and compensation will be discussed with suitable candidates before any work begins.
